stories.headline: GOLD HITS THREE-WEEK HIGH AS U.S. AND IRAN INCH TOWARD 60-DAY CEASEFIRE
stories.snippet: Gold surged more than 1.5% to $4,563/oz Friday after reports the US and Iran reached a political understanding on a 60-day ceasefire extension. Oil tumbled 1.5% as markets priced in Strait of Hormuz reopening. Gold is still tracking an 0.8% monthly decline despite the pop — inflation fears and higher-for-longer rate bets weigh.

stories.headline: GFG RESOURCES HITS DISTRICT-SCALE GOLD AT NAHANNI — 11.2 G/T AU ON FIRST PROGRAM
stories.snippet: GFG Resources (TSXV: GFG) drilled 10 holes along 6 km of the Pipestone Deformation Zone on the Goldarm Property in Ontario's Timmins Gold District — every single hole hit gold. Best intercept: 11.20 g/t Au. This is the company's first regional drill campaign outside its Aljo-Montclerg areas; a $5.0–5.5M 2026 program with 10 km of diamond drilling planned across the 263 km² land package.

stories.headline: NEVGOLD PULLS 53.7% ANTIMONY OFF NEVADA SURFACE — ONE OF FEW NEAR-TERM U.S. SUPPLIERS
stories.snippet: NevGold Corp. (TSXV: NAU) returned surface grades up to 53.7% antimony — six samples over 10%, fourteen over 2% — from pre-strip dump material at Limousine Butte in Nevada. Antimony is a top-priority U.S. critical mineral under Trump's Section 232 order. NevGold holds C$42M in treasury and targets domestic antimony production by 2027, making it one of a handful of near-term Western suppliers.

stories.headline: MONUMENT MINING'S SELINSING DRILL EXTENDS GOLD MINERALIZATION 70M BEYOND PIT SHELL
stories.snippet: Monument Mining (TSXV: MMY) released assay results from 23 holes in the Buffalo Reef/Felda areas at its Selinsing Gold Mine in Malaysia. One hole extends gold mineralization 70 metres down-dip beyond the current Expanded Pit Shell. Stage 1 and 2 of a 123-hole program are underway; full assay results expected by June 2026.

stories.headline: UBS AND HSBC: SILVER IS "FUNDAMENTALLY OVERVALUED" — DEMAND DESTRUCTION ACCELERATING
stories.snippet: Silver fell 3.7% to $72.13/oz Thursday as two major bank desks sounded the alarm. UBS said silver's 140% rally in 2025 is now causing industrial buyers to cut back: "Demand erosion is likely to persist." HSBC called the metal "fundamentally overvalued" and flagged limited upside. Spot silver is still up 150%+ year-over-year but the bull thesis is getting tested at these levels.

stories.headline: MOGOTES METALS SURGES 159% IN ONE WEEK ON COPPER-GOLD DISCOVERY NEXT TO FILO DEL SOL
stories.snippet: Mogotes Metals (TSXV: MOG) is the TSX-V's top weekly performer with a 159% gain to a C$287M market cap. Its Filo Sur project in Argentina's Vicuña district returned 0.7% Cu, 0.55 g/t Au, 2.7 g/t Ag over 86 metres immediately adjacent to BHP and Lundin Mining's Filo del Sol deposit. Final assays still pending — a full result could move the stock again.

stories.headline: MARYLAND JOINS 44 STATES WITH GOLD AND SILVER SALES TAX EXEMPTION — SIGNED INTO LAW
stories.snippet: Maryland Governor Wes Moore signed SB 309 on May 26, restoring the state's sales tax exemption on gold and silver coins, bars, and rounds — effective July 1, 2026. Maryland had quietly removed the exemption in 2024 before dealer backlash reversed the decision. At least 44 U.S. states now treat precious metals purchases as tax-exempt.

stories.headline: GOLD-TO-SILVER RATIO COMPRESSES TO MULTI-YEAR LOW — HISTORICALLY BULLISH FOR SILVER
stories.snippet: The gold-silver ratio compressed from ~62:1 to ~55:1 in a single week in May 2026 — one of the fastest contractions in years. GoldSeek's weekly SWOT analysis argues the move echoes the setups that preceded major silver outperformance in 2009 and 2020. Contrarian warning: CNBC-cited analysts called silver overvalued in the same week. Worth watching both sides.

stories.headline: BAYHORSE SILVER BEGINS UNDERGROUND DRILLING AT OREGON MINE — FIRST PHASE 2,000 METRES
stories.snippet: Bayhorse Silver (TSXV: BHS) has completed underground drilling preparations at the Bayhorse Silver Mine in Oregon. The first phase 2,000-metre diamond drill program commences June 1, 2026. The mine is a past-producing silver-copper-cobalt operation; management is advancing toward resource delineation in a rising silver market.

stories.headline: MINRES MOBILIZES CREWS AT BALD HILL — AUSTRALIAN LITHIUM MINE BACK FROM 18-MONTH HALT
stories.snippet: Mineral Resources (ASX: MIN) is back at Bald Hill, Western Australia, with site mobilisation and workforce deployment underway this week. First spodumene concentrate production targets July 2026. The 165,000 dmt/yr operation was placed on care-and-maintenance in late 2024; restart costs are guided at A$20M. Once running, MinRes will be the only company globally operating three hard-rock lithium mines.

stories.headline: COPPER AT $6.40/LB — SECOND STRAIGHT MONTHLY ADVANCE AS AI DATA CENTERS DRIVE DEMAND
stories.snippet: Copper futures pushed to ~$6.40/lb in late May 2026, extending a second consecutive monthly advance on AI infrastructure and green energy demand. Chile's Cochilco raised its 2026 copper price forecast to $5.55/lb average on May 19, citing the energy transition, EVs, and AI as structural demand drivers. Supply constraints out of Chile remain the key wildcard — watch LME inventories.
